desc: Ideation: reduce to choosing 2K cakes and 3 colors with even color counts; baseline top-2K m_i gives an upper bound and parity correction by at most two operations.
Implement the primary solver using the baseline parity-correction method with top-3 candidate operation lists and brute-force one/two-operation disjointness check.
Validate the current solver on small random tests (N <= 8, all K, values 0..3 plus tie-heavy, all-zero, N=2K, and K=1 cases) against a brute-force exhaustive pairing or subset DP; no mismatch found.
